tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background and the arena. Text on it: ink, muted, accent.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Top bar, side panels, stage cards, sheets. Text on it: ink, muted, accent.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented controls, cards sitting on bg or panel. Text on it: ink, muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines, grid dots, track of a progress bar. Never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, beams, unselected node outlines, empty-slot outlines. At least 3:1 on bg, panel and panel-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: line-strong-glow
tokens.usage: Glow on a glowing lock or raised frame. Transparent in the paper theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, node outlines, readout values on bg, panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: ink-glow
tokens.usage: Glow on a selected flat button. Transparent in the paper theme.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, units, captions, disabled explanations on bg, panel and panel-raised (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one signal colour: primary action, live signal, firing neurons, motor arcs, cores, focus ring, progress fill. Reads on bg, panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Outline of the frame, top bar, side panels and cards: a solid teal in neon, a neutral warm grey in paper. Decorative; controls use line-strong.

tokens.name: edge-glow
tokens.usage: Glow on a glowing plain frame (the default panel kind). Transparent in the paper theme.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected-tool and current-cell wash behind ink text. Decorative; the state also needs a border or label.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Glow halo behind firing nodes. Decorative and removable; transparent in the paper theme.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: halo
tokens.usage: Selection and focus of a thing the player tapped: ring around a part, outline of a selected stage. Static, never pulses. Always with a name label.

tokens.name: halo-glow
tokens.usage: Glow on a selected primary button. Transparent in the paper theme.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Invalid anatomy and destructive actions, always with a warn icon and a plain sentence. Reads on bg and panel.

tokens.name: danger-glow
tokens.usage: Glow on a selected tertiary button. Transparent in the paper theme.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind a dialog or sheet. Decorative; the dialog itself carries the message.

tokens.name: output
tokens.usage: Outputs: motors and the neurons that drive them, when a part is inspected. Senses use accent. Never alone: always with a tag or a position.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Glow on primary buttons and active tools. Paper theme and data-effects=lite set it to none.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Screen, panel and dialog titles, and the name field in a bar.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Card titles and the part name in a settings panel.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names and values in lists and dialogs; emphasis inside a sentence.

styles.name: small-strong
styles.usage: Text inside a row, a field or a tab.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button and segmented text, upper case.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Helper lines under a control and captions under a figure.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Row labels in dense cards. One to three words.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Field and section labels, upper case.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: Distance, generations and other big numbers.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Live values in stage cards and the brain view.

styles.name: readout-md
styles.usage: A value beside its label in a panel; stepper symbols.

styles.name: readout-sm
styles.usage: Ticks, cell numbers and axis labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label. Gap inside a control. Inset between a button and the edge of a bar.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a row or between rows. Screen edge inset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside a panel, card or menu row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between panels and cards. Horizontal padding of a text button.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections and larger groups.

tokens.name: control-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, badges and status pills.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense rows: a picker row, a stepper, a value row inside a panel.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Visible height of a button, icon button, field, segmented control and toggle row. The touch area around it is 48px.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target and the height of a top bar and of a menu row in the 640 x 360 design canvas.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icon inside a chip or a dense row.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icon beside text in a button, field or row.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icon in an icon button, a menu row and a part glyph.

tokens.name: icon-xl
tokens.usage: Large icon: an empty state or a hero action.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, progress cells, generation cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, rows, segmented controls and callouts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs, sheets and the device frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and unlock chips.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers, grid dots and ruler ticks.

tokens.name: stroke-beam
tokens.usage: Beams in the arena and builder.

tokens.name: stroke-signal
tokens.usage: Motor arcs and the heaviest network edges.

tokens.name: w-rail
tokens.usage: Width of the tool rail: touch + space-2.

tokens.name: w-side
tokens.usage: Width of the side panel. The arena takes the rest.

tokens.name: h-screen
tokens.usage: Height of a screen body: the 360 canvas minus the 48 top bar.

tokens.name: w-brain
tokens.usage: Drawing area of the brain: a fixed size, it is a figure.

tokens.name: w-well
tokens.usage: Width of a framed drawing well.

tokens.name: h-well
tokens.usage: Height of a framed drawing well.

tokens.name: h-stage
tokens.usage: Height of a stage tile figure.

tokens.name: h-thumb
tokens.usage: Height of a thumbnail clip.

tokens.name: w-tile
tokens.usage: Width of one tile in the stage strip (SignalFlow, Themes, Training).

tokens.name: w-col-xs
tokens.usage: Stage-strip row: the label column ("Touch", "Speed"...), so the bar after it lines up row to row.

tokens.name: w-col-sm
tokens.usage: Stage-strip row: the bar's width.

tokens.name: w-col-md
tokens.usage: A short readout column.

tokens.name: w-col-lg
tokens.usage: A longer readout column.

tokens.name: w-col-xl
tokens.usage: A wide readout column.
